svg.title: Which way a question goes, decided on the phone.
svg.text: Which way a question goes, decided on the phone.
Each question takes one path. What the app holds exactly it answers itself; the rest is searched and written by a model.
Answered by the app, in seconds
Writes from the passages and cites them; the draft
is checked and reviewed before it shows.
Drawn from the app's research pipeline in version 1.4.2. The same flow as text is in docs/how-it-works.md.
